headword: {自宅|じたく}{学習|がくしゅう}

definitions.explanation: The practice of studying or learning at one's own home rather than at school or another institution. Used broadly for homework-style study, remote learning, and self-directed education.

examples.japanese: {自宅|じたく}{学習|がくしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ふ}やした→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧。
examples.english: I increased my time spent studying at home.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{自宅|じたく}{学習|がくしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It's important to help children develop a habit of studying at home.

examples.japanese: ⟦コロナ{禍|か}→コロナ禍：29315_koronaka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{自宅|じたく}{学習|がくしゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当|あ}たり{前|まえ}→当たり前：01685_atarimae⟧になった⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: During the pandemic, home study became the norm at many schools.

examples.japanese: {自宅|じたく}{学習|がくしゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{集中力|しゅうちゅうりょく}→集中力：17614_shuuchuuryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: It's hard to maintain concentration when studying at home.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{自宅|じたく}→自宅：00129_jitaku⟧ (one's home) and ⟦{学習|がくしゅう}→学習：02623_gakushuu⟧ (study; learning). Became especially common during and after the COVID-19 pandemic as schools and universities shifted to remote formats.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自宅|じたく}{学習|がくしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: home study time
- {自宅|じたく}{学習|がくしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧: home study habit
- {自宅|じたく}{学習|がくしゅう}{日|び}: home study day (school-designated day for studying at home)
- {自宅|じたく}{学習|がくしゅう}⟦{教材|きょうざい}→教材：12878_kyouzai⟧: home study materials

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{家庭|かてい}{学習|がくしゅう}→家庭学習：24708_kateigakushuu⟧: home study — nearly synonymous, slightly more formal
- ⟦{独学|どくがく}→独学：09601_dokugaku⟧: self-study — emphasizes learning without a teacher
- ⟦{通信|つうしん}{教育|きょういく}→通信教育：09975_tsuushinkyouiku⟧: correspondence/distance education — more structured and institution-based
